provenance: Positions mined from Tenhou houou-room logs redistributed by tenhou-to-mjai under CC BY 4.0, from games held out of model training. Expected values are computed by akochan's expected-value search in Tenhou houou placement points (+90/+45/0/-135); candidates are found by a 2.2M-parameter imitation network trained on 20M houou decisions, which also supplies the corroborating ranking. Positions where the two evaluators disagreed on the best action were discarded rather than adjudicated.
